title: Portrait of Baroness Elisabeth Bachofen-Echt, Gustav Klimt, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Symbol of loyalty, harmony and a shared journey Iconic work of Viennese Secession in collectible form Decorated with natural amber of unique texture Baroness Elisabeth gazes with grace and quiet strength — wrapped in a pattern that blends the richness of Art Nouveau with feminine delicacy. Klimt captured the spirit of his era: elegance, sensuality, and the subtle nostalgia of the fin de siècle. This silver coin, adorned with natural amber, becomes a collector’s tribute to a masterpiece that transcends time.
